sources.label: Official Protest product-page size chart, women's dress (chest/waist/hips, cm)
Official Protest product-page size guide, Women tops (chest/waist, cm; adds XXXL)

audit: Old URL protest.eu/en-gb/size-guide 404s; the UK site (protest.eu/en/gb) has no standalone size guide. Product-page charts, cm: 'Women tops' (same on a t-shirt and a fleece) prints chest and waist XS/34-XXXL/46; a women's dress prints chest, waist and hips XS/34-XXL/44 with identical chest/waist; ski trousers print the same waist and hips. XXXL has no hip value (the trousers chart lists XXXL/46 but prints only six waist/hip values). UK/US removed (not printed). Old M (UK 10) 88/70/94 -> M/38 chest 89-92, waist 73-76, hips 96-99. XXL and XXXL added.
